name: Friedrich Engels
role: German philosopher, revolutionary socialist and co-founder of Marxism (1820-1895)
summary: Engels co-wrote the Communist Manifesto with Marx and, in works such as Anti-Dühring, Socialism: Utopian and Scientific and The Origin of the Family, set out a materialist account of history, class struggle, the state as a class instrument and a planned classless society that would abolish private property, money and religion's social basis. He favoured a democratic republic, universal suffrage and an independent workers' party, while holding revolution justified and defending the Paris Commune as the dictatorship of the proletariat; late in life he stressed mass electoral organisation over minority uprisings.

notes: Joint works with Marx are counted as his words.
